items.title: Mark Soskin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 17, 2021
items.q: I got a call from ... 'it’s for Jimmy Ponder, you want to do it?' I said, 'Yeah, sure ... I’d love to do it.' ... And so then what I did, I started checking out Jimmy’s music ... we did, on that record date, 'The Creator Has a Master Plan.'

ctx.x: Can you describe to me if I looked, I’m looking at your sideman list right now and I’ll pick okay Jimmy Ponder.
So you get a call — tell me how that whole thing works.
